TAMM CHARACTER DIRECTION:
No TAMM character. Keep the opening conceptual and editorial; reveal brand at the end only.

SOUND DIRECTION:
Precision sound design: restrained mechanical rhythm, abrupt near-silence at the interruption, one low impact on the question, clean resolve. No EDM drop or stock corporate music.

BRAND / FACTUAL NON-NEGOTIABLES:
Use SayTamm's Dark Editorial Performance system: Obsidian #09090D, Graphite #17171E, Soft White #F5F3FA, muted #96939F, Electric Purple #6C35FF as a restrained accent (about 10% or less). • Creative Director: protect the single-minded idea, emotional arc, originality and brand distinction. Reject generic agency tropes.
• Art Director: define composition, visual metaphor, lighting, camera language, negative space, hierarchy and visual continuity.
• Social Media Head: make the first 1–2 seconds / first carousel slide stop the scroll; design native crops, safe zones, subtitle pacing and platform adaptations.
• Content Head: protect the message, clarity, factual accuracy, bilingual meaning and the hook-to-payoff structure.

• AI Video Specialist: generate controlled shots with reference locking, shot continuity, motion constraints and clean plates; avoid morphing, text hallucination and logo distortion.
• Social Video Editor: edit for retention, rhythm, captions, sound, platform-safe framing and a decisive end frame. Deliver clean masters and platform exports.

2. Generation: create clean visual plates without text or logos. Generate shots separately when this improves control. Use image/reference conditioning for the approved TAMM design when specified. Preserve object identity, geometry and lighting across shots.
3. Design: set final Arabic and English typography separately. Arabic is not a line-by-line mirror; compose it natively RTL. Keep all critical copy inside platform-safe zones.
4. Edit: create a strong first frame, remove dead air, maintain a clear visual progression, use accurate subtitles and finish with a legible CTA / approved brand lockup.
5. QA: review spelling, Arabic shaping, English British spelling, logo geometry, character continuity, factual claims, mobile legibility, audio peaks, safe margins and platform exports.

DELIVERABLES:
• Master visual: 9:16 vertical master; add 16:9 only where the concept requires it.
• Separate Arabic and English text layers / exports; do not combine both scripts into a crowded single frame.
• Clean version without captions plus captioned version.
• Editable project/source file and final high-quality export.
• Thumbnail / cover frame with the hook readable at phone size.

misspelled text, pseudo-Arabic, broken glyphs, distorted logo, mirrored diagonal, changed TAMM face or body, extra fingers/limbs, unstable hands, flicker, morphing, warped geometry, random UI, fabricated numbers, stock-photo look, clutter, excessive purple, neon glow, particles, fake office, fake employees, fake client work, generic handshake imagery, weak opening frame, tiny text, unsafe crop, or a CTA that cannot be read.

title: Agency clichés
purpose: إظهار التمايز بنقد عادات شائعة في التسويق، دون مهاجمة منافسين أو ادعاءات عن السوق.
hook_ar: 3 جمل بنسمعها كتير… ومش كفاية لوحدها.
hook_en: Three familiar agency lines — and why they are not enough.
core_ar:
«هنزود المحتوى.»
«هنعمل حملة أكبر.»
«هنبعتلك تقرير آخر الشهر.»

كل ده ممكن يكون جزء من الشغل. لكنه مش إجابة عن السؤال الأساسي: إيه المشكلة اللي بنحلّها؟ وإزاي هنعرف إننا اتحركنا للأمام؟

المحتوى محتاج هدف. الحملة محتاجة فرضية واضحة. والتقرير لازم يساعدنا ناخد القرار اللي بعده.

في قول تم، بنفضّل السؤال الصح على الإجابة الجاهزة.
core_en:
“We’ll post more.”
“We’ll run a bigger campaign.”
“We’ll send the report at month-end.”

Each may have a place in the work. None is a strategy on its own.

What problem are we solving? What needs to change? And what evidence will tell us whether we are moving in the right direction?

Content needs a purpose. A campaign needs a clear hypothesis. A report should inform the next decision.

At SayTamm, we prefer the right question to a ready-made answer.
visual: 5-slide premium editorial carousel. Slide 1 bold question; slides 2–4 each cliché phrase set in oversized typography with a precise annotation; slide 5 reframes into three questions: Problem? Objective? Evidence? Black/white grid with purple used only as a small marker. No stock imagery.

purpose: عرض التفكير متعدد المسارات من خلال سيناريو افتراضي، دون حالة عميل أو وعد بنتيجة.

core_ar:
تخيّل نشاطاً عنده زيارات للموقع، لكن الطلبات أقل من المتوقع.

هل الحل إعلان أكتر؟ مش بالضرورة.

ممكن نراجع:
- العرض والرسالة: هل القيمة واضحة؟
- تجربة الموقع: هل الوصول للقرار سهل؟
- جودة الزيارات: هل بنوصل للجمهور المناسب؟

دي 3 مسارات تشخيص محتملة، والبيانات هي اللي تحدد الأولوية. مفيش حل واحد يصلح لكل نشاط.
core_en:
Imagine a business receiving website visits but fewer orders than expected.

Is the answer more advertising? Not necessarily.

The diagnosis could start in three places:
- Offer and message: is the value clear?
- Website experience: is it easy to make a decision?
- Traffic quality: are the right people arriving?

These are three possible routes, not a universal formula. Evidence should determine the priority.

motion: 12–15 sec, 9:16. Open with one central node; branch into three lanes; each lane gets a 1-line diagnostic; paths converge into 'Evidence decides'. Smooth precise transitions, strong typographic rhythm.
tamm: TAMM may appear briefly as a guide at the branching point, but not as the solution itself.
sound: Three distinct soft ticks for the branches, then one resolved tonal note. Keep effects minimal.

Choosing the right metric starts with the business objective, not the report.

purpose: تذكير عملي: تحديد الهدف وطريقة القياس قبل ترويج أي منشور.
hook_en: The Boost button is not a strategy.
core_ar:
قبل ما تضغط Boost، اسأل نفسك:

- أنا عايز أوصل لمين؟
- عايز الشخص يعمل إيه بعد ما يشوف المحتوى؟
- هقيس النجاح بإيه؟

لو هدفك زيارات، اختار قياس يناسب الزيارات. لو هدفك Leads، لازم تبص على جودة الـ Leads مش عددها بس.

core_en:
Before you hit Boost, ask yourself:

- Who exactly do I want to reach?
- What should someone do after seeing this content?
- Which metric will define success?

If the goal is traffic, measure traffic quality. If the goal is leads, look beyond lead volume and assess lead quality.

The tool is not the plan. The objective should determine how you use it.

3. What decision will we make next?

01 Strategy: defines the objective, audience and priority.

A confident brand film built from typographic statements, brand diagonal geometry, abstract material environments and approved logo assets. Avoid generic city montages, stock teams, fake dashboards and AI-generated client work. End with official logo and contact email.

MOTION / EDITING DIRECTION:
20–25 sec, 16:9 master plus 9:16 and 1:1 adaptations. Sequence: objective → strategy → creative → media → measurement → brand reveal. Use clean cuts, purposeful camera movement and precise type. Render Arabic and English masters separately to protect RTL and legibility.

TAMM CHARACTER DIRECTION:
TAMM appears in one short supporting beat near the brand reveal. The logo remains the hero and must be inserted from supplied vector/raster master.

SOUND DIRECTION:
Premium restrained sonic identity: build through the four disciplines, resolve on the brand reveal. No cliché orchestral crescendo.

BRAND / FACTUAL NON-NEGOTIABLES:
Use SayTamm's Dark Editorial Performance system: Obsidian #09090D, Graphite #17171E, Soft White #F5F3FA, muted #96939F, Electric Purple #6C35FF as a restrained accent (about 10% or less). English type: Satoshi. Arabic type: IBM Plex Sans Arabic. Premium editorial, confident hierarchy, generous negative space, purposeful motion.
Use only supplied official SayTamm logo artwork. NEVER redraw, approximate, regenerate, distort, rotate, recolour, add shadow/gradient, or mirror its diagonal. Insert logo in post from the supplied master asset on a solid approved background. Do not ask an image/video model to render legible Arabic or English typography; add typography in post. Do not use generic stock people, fabricated team/office footage, fake dashboards, invented metrics, client logos, or AI-generated client campaign examples. AI imagery is decorative/conceptual only. No neon overload, glow effects, particles, generic agency templates, or cliché city montages. Keep Arabic composition natively RTL; never mirror the English layout.

MULTIDISCIPLINARY CREATIVE EXECUTION — mandatory role ownership:
• Creative Director: protect the single-minded idea, emotional arc, originality and brand distinction. Reject generic agency tropes.
• Art Director: define composition, visual metaphor, lighting, camera language, negative space, hierarchy and visual continuity.
• Social Media Head: make the first 1–2 seconds / first carousel slide stop the scroll; design native crops, safe zones, subtitle pacing and platform adaptations.
• Content Head: protect the message, clarity, factual accuracy, bilingual meaning and the hook-to-payoff structure.
• Digital Strategist: ensure the asset communicates a real business insight and supports the launch funnel; do not promise outcomes or fabricate proof.
• Senior Graphic Designer: execute a strict grid, typography, contrast, spacing and legibility system; add all final text in post-production, not inside generative imagery.
• AI Video Specialist: generate controlled shots with reference locking, shot continuity, motion constraints and clean plates; avoid morphing, text hallucination and logo distortion.
• Social Video Editor: edit for retention, rhythm, captions, sound, platform-safe framing and a decisive end frame. Deliver clean masters and platform exports.

PRODUCTION PLAN:
1. Pre-production: lock the message, approved logo file, type system, aspect ratios and references. Build an asset list and storyboard before generation.
2. Generation: create clean visual plates without text or logos. Generate shots separately when this improves control. Use image/reference conditioning for the approved TAMM design when specified. Preserve object identity, geometry and lighting across shots.
3. Design: set final Arabic and English typography separately. Arabic is not a line-by-line mirror; compose it natively RTL. Keep all critical copy inside platform-safe zones.
4. Edit: create a strong first frame, remove dead air, maintain a clear visual progression, use accurate subtitles and finish with a legible CTA / approved brand lockup.
5. QA: review spelling, Arabic shaping, English British spelling, logo geometry, character continuity, factual claims, mobile legibility, audio peaks, safe margins and platform exports.

DELIVERABLES:
• Master visual: 9:16 vertical master; add 16:9 only where the concept requires it.
• Separate Arabic and English text layers / exports; do not combine both scripts into a crowded single frame.
• Clean version without captions plus captioned version.
• Editable project/source file and final high-quality export.
• Thumbnail / cover frame with the hook readable at phone size.

NEGATIVE PROMPT / REJECT IF:
misspelled text, pseudo-Arabic, broken glyphs, distorted logo, mirrored diagonal, changed TAMM face or body, extra fingers/limbs, unstable hands, flicker, morphing, warped geometry, random UI, fabricated numbers, stock-photo look, clutter, excessive purple, neon glow, particles, fake office, fake employees, fake client work, generic handshake imagery, weak opening frame, tiny text, unsafe crop, or a CTA that cannot be read.
